description: Baseline cont + forced sibling_of before dual-file edits
tool_guide:
## Tool guide (compact)
explore→plan→pack→edit→compile→map_review→done.
First step: plan with 4–8 path:Symbol. After pack: prefer edit. Tools max 4; refetch Truncated with path:A-B or #tail.
JSON only. edit hunks need unique multiline search. New API: edit .hpp decl + .cpp def together.
clarify only if Instruction has no concrete src/ path.
| tool | arg |
| get_code_of | path:Symbol|#tail|A-B |
| file_outline | path |
| search | needles |
| headers_of | path |
| sibling_of | path (.cpp↔.hpp) |
system_extra:
## Priority rules
- If Instruction names ≥2 concrete src/... paths, your final successful edit batch (or consecutive edits before done) MUST touch each named path.
- If Instruction asks for ≥2 markers/changes in one file, put them in one edit hunks[] or two edits before done — never leave one out.
- After compile OK (map_review), re-read Instruction; if any named path/marker missing from your edits, emit edit again — do not done yet.

## Sibling API rule
When Instruction names both .hpp and .cpp (or decl+def):
1) Call sibling_of on one named path before the first edit.
2) SAME action=edit MUST include hunks for BOTH files.
3) Compile undeclared/undefined ⇒ next edit MUST add the missing sibling hunk.

Keep JSON tiny.

user_overlays.edit: If Instruction has hpp+cpp: sibling_of first if needed, then hunks on BOTH files in this edit.
user_overlays.map_review: Before done: every Instruction path/marker must be in the diff. Dual-file APIs need both files.
user_overlays.pack: For dual-file APIs: resolve sibling_of then edit both loci now.
